the plasticized PVA-LiCF3SO3 complexed with LiClO4 exhibits the best ionic conductivity of 3.4 x 10-5 S/cm at room temperature.

plasticized PVA-based solid polymer electrolytes exhibit good ionic conductivity and the ionic conductivity of these polymer electrolyte films is enhanced by increasing temperature and by increasing the concentration of plasticizer.

the synthesis of PVA based SPE films and to understand the effect of plasticizer and various lithium salts on the ionic conductivity of these films.
the preparation, characterization and conductivity studies of PVA based SPEs complexed with different lithium salts.
the preparation of plasticized SPE films of high ionic conductivities.

the conductivity of SPE is influenced by the nature of the lithium salts and plasticizer.

the conductivity of SPEs is found to be strongly influenced by the nature of the plasticizer used.

the conductivity of the PVA-based SPEs is enhanced by the addition of plasticizer and the type of the lithium salt used.
